name: contribute
help:
pullboard contribute check <file> [shape]  print every failure of a contribution record file with its rule, fix and skill command; exits 1 when any
  pullboard contribute accept <file> [shape]  check the record the same way and, when the parser accepts it, save it under its hash and print the hash; a refused record prints the same failures, saves nothing and exits 1
  pullboard contribute check --issue <N> <shape>  the same check on the body of GitHub issue N
